### Task: Follow a Part from Arrival to Storage (about 10 min)

This is a small production line for machining **flange plates**. Raw castings (unmachined iron blanks) enter from the left, pass through two machine tools, and are sent by conveyor for inspection. Accepted parts go to the finished goods warehouse; rejected parts go to the scrap bin.

1. Click **Run** above the Workbench to start the simulation. Switch to the **3D** view and watch the parts move to the right one by one.
2. Switch to the **Flowchart** view: each block represents a piece of equipment, and the arrows show the parts' route. Compare it with the 3D view to see that each piece of equipment is the same in both views.
3. Open **Objectives & Answers** in the task panel on the left and answer the three questions. When you're done, click **Submit for Grading**.

**Success criteria**: Answer all three questions correctly to score 100 points and unlock the next lesson.

#### Why This Matters

No matter what a factory produces, the basic flow is much the same: **Incoming → Machining → Inspection → Storage**, connected by buffers and conveyors.
When you see a more complex workshop, start by looking for these elements to understand how parts move through it.
零件从左往右走。先运行，再在三维里盯住一件看它去了哪里。: Parts move from left to right. Start the simulation, then follow one part in 3D to see where it goes.
缓存自己不加工零件，只是临时放几件。: A buffer does not process parts; it only holds a few temporarily.
流程图里检测设备有两个出口：上面一条去成品仓库，另一条（不合格）去废品箱。: In the flowchart, the inspection equipment has two exits: the upper route leads to the finished goods warehouse, and the other route leads to the scrap bin for rejected parts.
零件在这条线上的先后顺序: The order of operations for parts on this line
零件先从毛坯来料进线，经过车床和加工中心加工，再由在线检测判合格不合格，合格的进: Parts enter the line as raw blanks, are machined on lathes and machining centers, and then undergo inline inspection to determine whether they pass or fail. Parts that pass go to the finished goods warehouse. Almost every workshop follows this sequence: Incoming → Machining → Inspection → Storage.
两台机床中间的\"缓存\"是干什么的: What is the "buffer" between two machine tools for?
存放做好的成品，等着发货: Storing finished goods until they are shipped
临时放几件零件：上一台做好了、下一台还没空时先放这里: Temporarily holding a few parts when the upstream machine has finished but the downstream machine is still busy
给机床供电: Supplying power to the machine tools
缓存自己不加工、不检测，只是在两台设备之间临时放几件零件。上一台做好了、下一台还: A buffer does not machine or inspect parts. It simply holds a few parts temporarily between two machines. When the upstream machine has finished but the downstream machine is still busy, parts go into the buffer so the upstream machine does not have to stop and wait.
检测判为不合格的零件去了哪里: Where do parts that fail inspection go?
回到毛坯缓存重新加工: Return to the raw casting buffer for rework
在线检测有两个出口：合格的往右进成品仓库，不合格的往下进废品箱。不合格品不会混进: Online inspection has two exits: accepted parts go right to the finished goods warehouse, and rejected parts go down to the scrap bin. Rejected parts will not be mixed with finished goods.

### Task: Identify Six Types of Equipment (About 15 Minutes)

This is the same line as in the previous lesson. This time, **identify** the following six items on the map. Under "Objectives and Answers," click "**Select on Map**" for a question, then click the equipment in the 3D view, floor plan, or process flow diagram.

| Question | Find | How to Identify It |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Incoming** | Parts enter the workshop here. It does not process them. |
| 2 | **Processing Equipment** (any one) | Parts change shape inside it, and processing takes some time. |
| 3 | **Buffer** (any one) | A temporary holding area for parts between two machines. It does not change the parts. |
| 4 | **Conveyor** | A long belt that moves parts from one place to another. |
| 5 | **Inspection** | Checks whether parts are acceptable; rejected parts are routed elsewhere. |
| 6 | **Finished Goods Warehouse** | Where accepted parts are stored at the end. |

If you select the wrong item, click "Select on Map" again to try again. Get all six right to earn 100 points.

> Not sure? Select an item. Its type (Incoming, Process, Buffer, etc.) appears at the top of the Properties panel on the right.

#### Why This Matters

When you are doing an internship in a workshop and your mentor says, "Get a part from Buffer 2" or "The conveyor is jammed again," you need to know which equipment they mean.
Recognizing equipment in 3D, on the floor plan, and in the process flow diagram all works the same way. The same skill will help you read diagrams and monitoring screens later.
平面图是从上往下看的车间地图，方块的位置就是设备在车间里的位置。: The floor plan is a top-down map of the workshop. The position of each block shows where the equipment is located.
缓存一般画得比较小，夹在两台机床中间。: A buffer is usually drawn as a small shape between two machine tools.
输送线是长条形的，零件在上面慢慢移动。: A conveyor is long and narrow, with parts moving slowly along it.
毛坯来料 SRC 在最左边，零件从这里进车间，它自己不加工。: Raw Casting Incoming SRC is at the far left. Parts enter the workshop here, and it does not process them.
1#数控车床 M1 和 2#加工中心 M2 都是加工设备：零件进去要待一段时间，: #1 CNC Lathe M1 and #2 Machining Center M2 are both processing equipment: a part enters, stays for a while, and comes out with a different shape. Select either one to answer correctly.
毛坯缓存 B0、车铣之间缓存 B1 都是缓存：夹在两台设备之间，只临时放零件，不: Raw Casting Buffer B0 and the buffer between turning and milling B1 are both buffers: they sit between two machines and hold parts temporarily without changing them.
输送线 CV1 是那条长条形的设备，零件在上面慢慢往检测区走，它只搬运、不加工。: Conveyor CV1 is the long piece of equipment. Parts move slowly along it toward the inspection area; it only transports them and does not process them.
在线检测 QC 判断零件合不合格，所以它后面有两条路：一条去成品仓库，一条去废品: Online Inspection QC determines whether parts pass inspection. That's why it has two paths after it: one to the finished goods warehouse and one to the scrap bin.
成品仓库 OUT 在最右边，检测合格的零件最后都到这里。: Finished Goods Warehouse OUT is at the far right. All parts that pass inspection end up here.

### Task: Follow a Part Through the Entire Process (about 15 minutes)

1. Click "Run", then switch to "**3D**".
2. Click "**Follow a Part**" above the 3D view. The camera will follow a part that has just entered the line, and the tracking bar at the bottom of the view shows **where it is now** (for example, "Being machined at #1 CNC Lathe" or "On the conveyor (40% complete)").
3. Watch until the tracking bar changes to "Stored: Finished Goods Warehouse". As you watch, note the **simulation clock** at the top of the Workbench each time the part reaches a new machine. To follow another part, click "Switch Part" in the tracking bar.
4. Click **#2 Machining Center** and check its **machining time** under "Cycle Time" in the properties panel on the right.
5. Answer the 4 questions below.

| Equipment | What it does |
|---|---|
| Raw Casting Incoming | Feeds in one raw casting every 90 seconds |
| #1 CNC Lathe | Turns the outer diameter and end face (the workpiece rotates, the tool does not) |
| #2 Machining Center | Drills holes and mills flat surfaces (the tool rotates, the workpiece does not) |
| Conveyor | Moves parts slowly to the inspection area; does not process them |
| Online Inspection | Measures dimensions and diverts out-of-tolerance parts to the scrap bin |
| Finished Goods Warehouse | Holds accepted parts until shipment |

#### Why This Matters

The time a part actually spends being processed is often much shorter than the time it spends moving along the line or waiting in a queue.
Following a part is the most direct way to find problems on the shop floor: wherever it waits the longest is a place worth improving.
跟踪栏的文字变了，就说明零件到了下一台设备；两次变化之间的仿真时间，就是它在上一: When the text in the tracking bar changes, the part has reached the next machine. The simulation time between two changes is how long it spent at the previous machine.
输送线 8 米长、每秒走 0.08 米。: The conveyor is 8 m long and runs at 0.08 m/s.
把每段时间加起来，就是一件零件从来料到入库的总时间。: Add the time for each segment to get the total time a part takes to go from incoming material to inventory.
一件零件在哪一段待的时间最长: Which segment does a part spend the most time in?
输送线 8 米长、每秒走 0.08 米，零件在上面要走约 100 秒；车床加工: The conveyor is 8 m long and runs at 0.08 m/s, so a part takes about 100 seconds to travel along it. The lathe takes 40 seconds to machine a part, the machining center takes 50 seconds, and inspection takes even less time. The part actually spends more time in transit than being machined.
一件零件从来料到进成品仓库，大约要多久: About how long does it take a part to go from incoming material to the finished goods warehouse?
把每一段加起来：车床 40 秒 + 加工中心 50 秒 + 输送线约 100 秒: Add up each stage: 40 s at the lathe + 50 s at the machining center + about 100 s on the conveyor + inspection, plus a little time in the buffer. A part takes about 3.5 min to go from incoming material to storage.
2#加工中心加工一件要多少秒: How many seconds does #2 Machining Center take to machine one part?
选中 2#加工中心，属性面板「节拍」里的加工时间写的是 50 秒。: Select #2 Machining Center. The processing time under "Cycle Time" in the Properties panel is 50 s.
零件进检测之前，最后经过的是哪台设备: Which piece of equipment does a part pass through last before inspection?
零件从加工中心出来先上输送线 CV1，由输送线送到在线检测，所以进检测之前最后经: After leaving the machining center, the part goes onto conveyor CV1, which takes it to inline inspection. The conveyor is therefore the last piece of equipment it passes through before inspection.

### Task: Understand equipment colors (about 15 min)

The color of equipment in the 3D view and flow diagram shows **what it is doing right now**:

| State | Meaning | Shop-floor expression |
|---|---|---|
| **Running** | Machining a part | "Working" |
| **Idle** | In working order, but not currently scheduled to work (for example, the shift has not started yet) | "Taking a break" |
| **Starved** | Ready to work, but no parts have arrived from upstream | "Waiting for parts", "Hungry" |
| **Blocked** | A part is finished, but downstream is full, so it cannot be released | "Backed up" |
| **Failed** | Broken down and under repair | "Down" |

On this line, lathe M1 takes 30 s per part, machining center M2 takes 60 s per part and occasionally breaks down, and deburring machine M3 takes 30 s per part. Each of the two buffers between them holds only 2 parts.

1. Run for more than 30 min of sim time (you can increase the speed) and watch how the colors of the three machines change.
2. Click a machine to see its current state in the Properties panel on the right. At the top, go to "Analysis" → "Time Breakdown" to see how much time each machine spends in each state.
3. Answer the questions below and click the corresponding equipment in the diagram.

#### Why learn this?

These are the colors a workshop manager checks every day: all green means everyone is working; if one machine is always "Starved", the problem is upstream; if one machine is always "Blocked", the problem is downstream.
Later, when you study bottlenecks and OEE, your calculations will be based on these five states.
M1 做得比 M2 快一倍，做好的零件 M2 来不及要，缓存 1 一满，M1 就: M1 works twice as fast as M2. M2 can't take the finished parts fast enough, so once Buffer 1 is full, M1...
M3 也比 M2 快一倍，M2 每 60 秒才给它一件，剩下的时间 M3 在……: M3 also works twice as fast as M2. M2 only sends it one part every 60 seconds, so the rest of the time M3 is...
看不出来就打开「分析」→「时间构成」，哪种颜色最长一目了然。: If you can't tell, open "Analysis" → "Time Breakdown". The longest bar makes it obvious.
\"做好了一件，可下游满了放不出去\"叫: "A part is finished, but the downstream station is full and can't take it" is called
做好了一件、下游却满了放不出去，这台设备只能干等着，车间里叫\"堵料\"。: A part is finished, but the downstream station is full and can't take it. The machine has to wait. On the shop floor, this is called "blocked."
\"能干活，可上游没送零件来\"叫: "The machine is ready to work, but no parts are coming from upstream" is called
设备是好的，可上游没把零件送过来，它没东西可做，这叫\"缺料\"（也叫\"等料\: The machine is working, but no parts are coming from upstream, so it has nothing to process. This is called "starved" (also known as "waiting for parts").
点出经常\"堵料\"的设备: Click a machine that is often "blocked"
M1 30 秒做一件，下游 M2 要 60 秒，中间缓存只能放 2 件，很快就满: M1 makes one part every 30 s, while downstream M2 needs 60 s. The buffer between them holds only 2 parts, so it fills up quickly. M1 can't send out the parts it finishes, and is often "blocked".
点出经常\"缺料\"的设备: Select the equipment that is often "starved"
M3 30 秒就能做完一件，可上游 M2 每 60 秒才给它一件，剩下一半时间它: M3 can finish one part in 30 s, but upstream M2 supplies one only every 60 s. M3 spends the other half of the time waiting for material.
这条线里只有 2#加工中心 M2 设了故障，时不时坏一下，坏的时候显示\"故障\: Only 2# Machining Center M2 is configured to fail on this line. It breaks down occasionally and shows "failure" when it does.
找问题：哪台设备在等料: Find the problem: Which machine is waiting for material?

### Task: The shift lead says, "Machine 3 has been stopped the whole time" (about 20 minutes)

This line usually produces more than 75 parts per hour, but today it is producing only about 40. The shift lead comes over and says, "3# Deburring Machine has been stopped the whole time. Is it broken?"

Don't rush to repair Machine 3. Please:

1. Run the simulation for at least 30 minutes and check the colors of the three machines and the part counts in the two buffers.
2. On the diagram, **select a machine that is continuously "starved"**.
3. Consider why it is starved. Follow the parts upstream and **select the machine that is actually causing the problem**.
4. Open that machine's properties and compare them with the **equipment records** below. Change any incorrect parameters back to the recorded values. Run the simulation again. The repair is complete when output returns to more than 70 parts per hour.

| Equipment | Record: Processing Time |
|---|---|
| 1# CNC Lathe M1 | normal(40,2) s |
| 2# Machining Center M2 | normal(45,2) s |
| 3# Deburring Machine M3 | normal(35,2) s |

> `normal(40,2)` means an average of 40 s, varying by a second or two per part.

#### Why Learn This

"Repair whichever machine is stopped" is one of the most common beginner mistakes. A stopped machine isn't necessarily broken; it may be waiting for material from upstream or blocked by downstream equipment.
Check the machine's status first, then follow the flow of parts to find the source of the problem. Fixing the right machine is what brings output back.
两个缓存都是空的，说明零件还没送到就被用光了——上游供不上。: Both buffers are empty, which means the parts are being used up before they can arrive. The upstream supply can't keep up.
缺料的设备往上游看，第一台\"一直在运行、自己从不缺料\"的就是嫌疑设备。: Look upstream from the starved machine. The first machine that is "running continuously and never starved" is the likely cause.
属性面板「节拍」里的加工时间和档案不一样的那台，就是出问题的设备。: The machine whose processing time in the "Cycle Time" field of the Properties panel doesn't match the equipment records is causing the problem.
点出一台一直在\"缺料\"的设备: Select a machine that is continuously "starved"
两个缓存都是空的，2#加工中心和 3#去毛刺机经常没零件可做，一直在\"缺料\": Both buffers are empty. #2 Machining Center and #3 Deburring Machine often have no parts to process and remain "starved". Select either machine to answer correctly.
上游送不过来零件，它在等料: Upstream cannot supply parts, so it is waiting for material
下游满了，它放不出去: Downstream is full, so it cannot release parts
3#去毛刺机没坏，它前面的缓存是空的，上游送不过来零件，它只能等料。停着的设备不: #3 Deburring Machine has not broken down. Its input buffer is empty because upstream cannot supply parts, so it has to wait. A stopped machine is not necessarily a broken machine.
顺着零件来的方向往上游找：1#数控车床一直在运行、自己从不缺料，可它的加工时间从: Trace the part flow upstream: #1 CNC Lathe keeps running and is never starved, but its machining time has increased from the documented 40 s to 90 s (the turning tool is dull), slowing down all downstream machines.
